mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings. Search snippet describes a King main bearing found out of spec on free spread, with a similar report attributed to a later production run.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Poster reports King STDX thrust bearings measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, and concludes King main bearings should not be used on these engines.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer complains about a quality-control problem and about the response they received; snippet indicates wrong parts were supplied and forum members felt King should have owned the error.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Buyer received a King SI bi-metal main bearing set with one shell malformed, crushed and twisted, and reports shaving material and oil inside the rod-bearing shrink wrap.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no King or official brand representative has replied and it remains open and unresolved.

mentions.title: King Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Thread includes a report of a King main bearing out of specification on free spread, with a King technician said to have advised against using them; other posters report good experience.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; still no King or official brand reply and it remains open and unresolved.
